'''Don Ralph Leonard'''<ref>{{cite web|title=Leonard, Don Ralph|url=https://www.fec.gov/data/candidate/H6OH15112/|publisher=Federal Election Commission|access-date=November 4, 2026}}</ref> (born 1977 or 1978)<ref name="dispatch20261009">{{cite web|title=Could GOP troubles put Carey's seat in play? It'd take a giant blue wave|url=https://www.dispatch.com/story/news/politics/elections/2026/10/09/could-don-leonard-flip-mike-careys-congressional-seat-for-democrats/91894222007/|last=Laird|first=Jordan|date=October 14, 2026|publisher=Columbus Dispatch|access-date=November 4, 2026}}</ref> is an American politician who is the representative-elect for [[Ohio's 15th congressional district]], being elected in the [[2026 United States House of Representatives elections in Ohio#District 15|2026 election]].<ref>{{cite web|title=In upset, Dem Don Leonard victorious over Carey in House race |url=https://www.dispatch.com/story/news/politics/elections/2026/11/03/columbus-u-s-house-election-results-in-mike-carey-don-leonard-joyce-beatty-races/92499087007/|last=Laird|first=Jordan|publisher=Columbus Dispatch|date=November 3, 2026|access-date=November 4, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Leonard wins Democratic primary for U.S. House seat, will face Carey in the fall|url=https://www.daytondailynews.com/local/leonard-wins-democratic-primary-for-u-s-house-seat-will-face-carey-in-the-fall/article_efa08e3e-56f0-51d5-b92c-8c65ee350ce5.html|publisher=Dayton Daily News|last=Frolik|first=Cornelius|date=May 5, 2026|access-date=November 4, 2026}}</ref> 

== Early life and career ==
Leonard grew up in [[Alaska]].<ref name="dispatch20261009"/> He was raised by a [[Single parent|single mother]]; his family struggled with [[Poverty|poverty]] and [[Homelessness|homelessness]].<ref name="dispatch20261006">{{cite web |title=Meet the candidates in Ohio's 15th Congressional District race |url=https://www.dispatch.com/story/news/politics/elections/candidate-profiles/2026/10/06/ohio-15th-congressional-district-seat-mike-carey-don-leonard-brennan-barrington/91591826007/ |publisher=The Columbus Dispatch |access-date=4 November 2026}}</ref>

graduated from the [[University of Massachusetts, Lowell]] with a bachelor's in political science in 2002 and a master's in regional economic and social development in 2004.<ref name="clas">{{cite web |title=Don Leonard |url=https://clas.osu.edu/people/leonard.471 |website=Center for Latin American Studies |publisher=The Ohio State University |access-date=4 November 2026}}</ref> He spent two years with the [[Peace Corps]] in [[Bolivia]] from 2004 to 2006.<ref name="clas"/> Following his volunteer service, Leonard earned master's and doctoral degrees in [[government]] from [[Cornell University]] in 2011 and 2014 respectively, focusing on [[Latin America]]n [[comparative politics]] and [[international relations]].<ref name="clas"/><ref name="cv">{{cite web|title=Don Leonard Curriculim Vitae|url=https://people.engineering.osu.edu/media/document/2025-08-27/cv-don-leonard-fall-2025.pdf|access-date=November 4, 2026}}</ref> 

Leonard held postdoctoral fellowships at [[Princeton University]] from 2013 to 2014 and [[Tulane University]] from 2014 to 2016.<ref name="cv"/> He joined [[Ohio State University]] in 2016 as a professional practice assistant professor of [[city and regional planning]].<ref name="cv"/> He resigned in January 2026 to campaign for Congress full-time.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Wozniak |first1=Emma |title=Democrat Don Leonard advances to face Rep. Mike Carey for Congress |url=https://www.dispatch.com/story/news/politics/elections/congressional/2026/05/05/democratic-primary-results-for-leonard-vs-miller-15th-congressional-district/89889538007/ |publisher=The Columbus Dispatch |access-date=4 November 2026}}</ref>

== U.S. House of Representatives ==
=== Elections ===
==== 2026 election ====
Leonard was the Democratic nominee in the 2026 15th congressional district election. His campaign emphasized the affordability of [[child care]], [[health care]], [[housing]], and [[ageing|aging]].<ref name="dispatch20261009"/><ref>{{cite web |title=What to know about the candidates running for Ohio's 15th Congressional District |url=https://www.10tv.com/article/news/politics/elections/what-to-know-about-the-candidates-running-for-ohio-15th-congressional-district-midterm-election-mike-carey-don-leonard/530-6f80b9e5-efef-420e-9f37-7354b4a43bd8 |publisher=WBNS-TV |date=9 October 2026 |access-date=4 November 2026}}</ref> 

On March 28, 2026, Leonard was arrested while participating in a [[No Kings protests|No Kings protest]] in [[Grove City, Ohio]]. Police cited him for violating a noise ordinance after he used a megaphone and charged him with obstructing official business after he refused an instruction to move toward police vehicles.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Shillcock |first1=George |title=Congressional candidate arrested at Grove City 'No Kings' protest after using megaphone |url=https://www.wosu.org/politics-government/2026-03-30/congressional-candidate-arrested-at-grove-city-no-kings-protest-after-using-megaphone |publisher=WOSU-FM |access-date=4 November 2026 |language=en |date=30 March 2026}}</ref> In an October interview with [[WOSU-FM]], Leonard said the charges had subsequently been dropped.<ref name="wosu2">{{cite web |last1=Shillcock |first1=George |title='Do Something Democrat' Don Leonard hopes to flip the script in Ohio's 15th Congressional District |url=https://www.wosu.org/politics-government/2026-10-05/do-something-democrat-don-leonard-hopes-to-flip-the-script-in-ohios-15th-congressional-district |publisher=WOSU |access-date=4 November 2026 |language=en |date=5 October 2026}}</ref>

In the May 5 Democratic primary, Leonard defeated former state representative Adam Miller with 52.9 percent of the vote.<ref name="Democratic Primary Results">{{Cite web|title=May 5, 2026 Primary/Special Election Official Canvass|url=https://publicfiles.ohiosos.gov/election-results/past-elections/2026/Primary+Special%20Election%20-%20May%205,%202026/group1/summary-level-official-results-2026-primary---democratic.xlsx|website=Ohio Secretary of State|access-date=June 5, 2026}}</ref> Leonard faced [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] incumbent [[Mike Carey (politician)|Mike Carey]] and [[Libertarian Party (United States)|Libertarian]] Brennan Barrington in the November 3 general election.<ref name="dispatch20261006"/> The [[Associated Press]] projected Leonard's victory that evening. The [[Amy Walter|Cook Political Report]] had rated the race as leaning Republican before the election.<ref name="wosu2"/>

==Political positions==
Leonard's political views have been categorized as [[Progressivism|progressive]].<ref name="dispatch20261009"/><ref name="datacenter">{{cite news |last=Nix |first=Naomi |title=Ohio's Data-Center Revolt Is Upending the Midterms |url=https://time.com/article/2026/10/29/ohio-data-center-revolt-upending-midterms/ |publisher=Time |date=October 29, 2026 |access-date=November 4, 2026}}</ref> He supports a "[[Single-payer healthcare#United States|Medicare for all]] who want it" [[public health insurance option]] and [[Universal child care|universal child care]].<ref name="dispatch20261009"/>

Leonard criticized [[data center]] development for imposing higher electricity costs and environmental risks on local communities. He described the facilities as "the mascot for predatory capitalism," connecting opposition to their expansion with broader concerns about [[Corporate capitalism|corporate power]] and [[Economic security|economic insecurity]].<ref name="datacenter"/>

In March 2026, Leonard supported [[Arms embargoes on Israel since 2023|ending U.S. weapons exports to Israel]] and reassessing the [[Israel–United States relations]]. He characterized Israel's military operations in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] as [[Gaza genocide|genocidal]] and pledged not to accept donations from [[AIPAC]].<ref>{{cite news |last=Catenacci |first=Thomas |title='As-Salamu Alayku': Dem House Candidate Deletes Video Condemning 'Genocide in Gaza' And 'Terrors That Are Happening With Our ICE Agents' |url=https://freebeacon.com/democrats/as-salamu-alaykum-dem-house-candidate-deletes-video-condemning-genocide-in-gaza-and-terrors-that-are-happening-with-our-ice-agents/ |publisher=The Washington Free Beacon |date=October 7, 2026 |access-date=November 4, 2026}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Leonard lives in [[The Hilltop (Columbus, Ohio)|The Hilltop]] in Columbus, Ohio, with his wife and daughter.<ref name="dispatch20261009"/>
